description: Price a transfer or conversion: rate, fee, amount received and estimated delivery. Creates nothing the user sees and moves no money. Give either send_amount (in source_currency) or receive_amount (in target_currency).

profile.description: Profile id from list_profiles, "personal", "business" or part of the profile name

receive_amount.description: Amount the recipient should get, in target_currency (give this or send_amount)

recipient_id.description: Saved recipient, for an exact price and delivery time

send_amount.description: Amount to send, in source_currency (give this or receive_amount)

target_currency.description: Currency the recipient gets, e.g. RON (same as source_currency for a same-currency transfer)

name: get_quote

pay_in_options.description: Price per payment method, cheapest first (methods with the same price merged)

target.description: What the recipient gets, when paid from the Wise balance

title: Get a Wise quote
